last_event.text:
To add a YouTube video to OptiSigns, follow these steps:

* Go to **Files/Assets**, select **Apps**, and choose the **YouTube** app.
* Enter an asset **Name** and paste the link to your video in the **URL** field.
* (Optional) Adjust **Display Options** (Caption, Mute) or **Playback Options** (Start At, End At).
* Click **Save** to add the video to your Assets.
* Go to the **Screens** tab, click **Edit** next to your screen, select **Asset** as the Content Type, pick your YouTube asset, and click **Save**.

Article URL: https://support.optisigns.com/hc/en-us/articles/360051014713-How-to-Use-YouTube-with-OptiSigns
